item.title: Back issues of Nordic Wittgenstein Review now available as print on demand
item.description: We intend to make all published issues, with the exception of volumes 1 and 2 (which were not published by the Nordic Wittgenstein Society) available for order as print on demand softcover copies in the near future. The content of the printed issues is identical with the online publications, but as many readers have expressed a wish to have the journal available also in a print version, we are happy to be able to offer this solution.

item.title: NWR introduces continuous submission/publication
item.description: As of Vol. 9 (2020) NWR changes its publication model from 2 issues/year to one of continuous submission/publication. See our Continuous Publication FAQ for details.

item.title: NEW ISSUE: NWR Special Issue 2026: Moral Understanding
item.description: NWR’s fourth Special Issue, Moral Understanding, guest edited by Hugo Strandberg and Salla Aldrin Salskov, has now been published. The special issue contains an introduction by the editors and contributions by David Cockburn, Christopher Cordner, Hugo Strandberg, Göran Torrkulla, Hannes Nykänen, Camilla Kronqvist, Joel Backström, Salla Aldrin Salskov & Philip Strammer, Niklas Toivakainen, and Fredrik Westerlund.
